subject: Novacare: preflight ownership and kickoff checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novacare.health>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@novacare.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novacare preflight: summary, ownership ask, and kickoff window

Hi Olivia / Ben —

Great to have Novacare as a committed customer. Quick summary and asks so we can move to the implementation phase without friction:

Deal snapshot
- ARR: $420k first year (pilot + committed volume)
- Committed throughput: ~120M tokens / month during pilot ramp; expected steady-state 200M tokens / month
- Model: redwood-13b-quant (hosted) with option to move to Private (VPC) in Q1 2027
- Go-live target: pilot acceptance by 2026-12-15

Immediate asks from Sales -> CS
1) Assign CSM and Implementation owner for kickoff & SOW acceptance (see suggested owners below).
2) Confirm pilot start week availability (we're proposing a Sprint 0 during week of 2026-11-15).
3) Share compliance requirements (data residency, KMS, SOC2 evidence). We attached the draft SOW + mutual action plan.

Suggested internal owners (proposal):
- CSM: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com)
- Implementation Lead: Tessa Morgan (tessa.morgan@redwood.com)
- Solution Architect (ops support): Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com)

Attachments: NOVACARE_SOW_v1.pdf, MutualActionPlan_Novacare.xlsx

Next steps
- Monica: will pick up CSM ownership and schedule a 60-minute kickoff with Novacare.
- Karthik / Irene: we'll close PO and procurement items while Monica drives tech intake.

Olivia/Ben — if that owner slate looks ok, Monica will reach out with a kickoff agenda and intake form.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: (internal)
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novacare preflight: summary, ownership ask, and kickoff window

Thanks Irene — quick clarifications before Monica schedules the kickoff:

1) Deployment mode: Novacare indicated preference for hosted initially but wrote "require option to move to Private in Q1". We should note that the SOW needs a clause for migration support and a target window.
2) Data residency: they require data at-rest and processing within US-East for HIPAA scope. Need to confirm whether hosted clusters in us-east meet our default encryption/KMS posture or if a dedicated VPC + KMS key will be needed.
3) Capacity / SLA: estimate we should reserve a small Dedicated pool (2x p4d-equivalent) for pilot to avoid noisy neighbor risk. Monica — can you confirm whether we want to request a dedicated reserve under the deal?
4) Procurement: PO expected by 2026-11-12 per Ben. If procurement slips, we'll eat into the sprint0 timeline.

Also, flagging an outstanding compliance packet request: Novacare asked for SOC2 Type II evidence + data flow diagram. I uploaded our SOC2 redacted pack to the Drive link in the mutual action plan.

Irene — if you want me to start the Dedicated capacity approval, I can open the internal request; otherwise let's treat hosted w/ dedicated pool as plan A.

-Karthik
Account Executive

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novacare.health>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@novacare.health>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: CSM ownership accepted + proposed kickoff agenda and intake

Hi all — happy to own CSM for Novacare. Olivia / Ben — pleased to meet you (virtually). I will run the kickoff and coordinate the technical intake.

Proposed kickoff agenda (60 mins)
- Introductions + success criteria (10m)
- Contract & timeline review (5m)
- Technical intake: integration pattern, auth, data residency (20m)
- Pilot plan & acceptance criteria (10m)
- Next steps & responsibilities (15m)

Immediate asks for Novacare (to prepare):
- Point-of-contact for technical integration (API owner)
- Any network/IP allowlist constraints
- Confirmation on KMS / key management preference
- Availability for Sprint 0 (week of 11/15)

I've attached a short CS intake template (CS_Intake_Form.md) and will post a calendar invite once we confirm availability. Monica will also collect the SOC2 artifact link if you haven't shared it.

Action items assigned
- Monica: schedule kickoff, send intake form, capture acceptance criteria
- Karthik: confirm PO date and whether we should reserve dedicated capacity (planner to open internal capacity request if yes)
- Irene: finalize SOW redlines with Novacare (if any)

Thanks — I'll be in touch with proposed time slots.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Novacare preflight — handoff to Implementation (please review)

Tessa / Marcus — forwarding the thread to bring you up to speed. Novacare is passing pilot acceptance by 12/15; initial ask is hosted with an option to migrate to Private/VPC in Q1.

Key technical notes pulled from the customer:
- Expected peak concurrent requests: ~120 reqs/sec during peak ramp, avg latency requirement < 300ms p95 for prompt pipeline
- Integration: REST API to our generative endpoint, batch embedding jobs for nightly processing (~50k items/day)
- Security/compliance: US-East data residency, SOC2 evidence requested, prefer customer-managed keys for Private migration

Suggested implementation staffing and immediate requests:
- Implementation lead: Tessa Morgan (owner for Sprint 0 and go/no-go)
- CSM: Monica Patel (customer liaison, success metrics)
- Solution Architect: Marcus Lin (capacity planning + performance tuning)

Attachments / links: MutualActionPlan_Novacare.xlsx, NOVACARE_SOW_v1.pdf, CS_Intake_Form.md

Please confirm you can run Sprint 0 the week of 2026-11-15. If we need dedicated reserve, Karthik will open the internal capacity request (per his note).

Got it — I'll take Implementation lead.

Immediate plan:
- I will run Sprint 0 planning and propose two time slots for a planning session: 2026-11-09 10:00-11:00 PST or 2026-11-10 14:00-15:00 PST. Please let me know preferred.
- Marcus: can you validate capacity estimates (2x p4d-equivalent) and confirm if we can stage a dedicated pool for pilot? If not, propose mitigation for noisy neighbor risk.
